unsupported: Lighthouse Woodworking was founded in 1995 by craftsman Ron Light in Boyce, Virginia.
The shop began as a one-man operation focused on custom-built hardwood furniture, emphasizing a personal relationship between maker and client.
Each item is hand-crafted with traditional joinery such as through-dovetails, mortise-and-tenon, and custom crown molding.
The workshop handles design, milling, assembly, and finishing in-house.
